summary: The red-box referral criteria are largely well encoded in one Urgent priority rule. Most consequential: the common-faint rule drops 'lasting < 15 seconds' and 'rapid recovery', and the glucose 'unable to measure' branch is missing. Stroke and TIA rules are identical and ungated by the no-seizure branch.
